hero.title: Choose Your Hero
hero.role.warrior: Frontline bruiser — tough, relentless, hits like a landslide.
hero.role.ninja: Shadow hunter — crits, poison and evasion.
hero.role.yacha: Dark knight-mage — flame, ghosts and curses.
hero.role.wolfman: Wolf-blooded hunter — claws, bleeding and speed.
hero.sexOnly.m: This class can only be played as a man.
hero.sexOnly.f: This class can only be played as a woman.
hero.baseTip: Starting values before gear, talents and the empire bonus.
hero.collectionTip: Gear pieces collected for this class. Bosses drop them — the Armory lists every drop table.
hero.lookTip: The armor you wear decides how the hero looks in the run.
hero.doc.basicTip: Fires on its own, all run long — no button needed.
hero.doc.poolTip: Skills this doctrine can offer on level-up.
hero.hint.touch: Tap a class, a doctrine and an empire, then continue.
hero.gearHint: Bosses drop gear for this class.
hero.statTip: Pips: how this class ranks against the other four. Values are the starting stats before gear, talents and the kingdom bonus.
